title: 4× unused argument (W0613): `algorithm`, `length`, `kwargs` (L75); `kwargs` (L91)
detail: `create_key` (line 75) accepts `algorithm`, `length`, and `**kwargs` but ignores them — the implementation unconditionally returns the pre-configured key ID regardless of the requested algorithm or key size. `create_key_pair` (line 91) likewise ignores `**kwargs`. These signatures are required by the key manager abstract interface, so the unused parameters are intentional interface slots. However, silently ignoring `algorithm` and `length` means a caller requesting AES-256 will silently get a key of whatever size is configured, with no error or warning. Fix: log a warning when `algorithm` or `length` differ from the configured key's properties.
